messages:
claire: Quick lock for Friday 09:00 PT announce. Need final changelog permalink, canonical docs URL, and the staging preview for social cards by 4pm so comms can schedule.

josh: I still have one note in the changelog about dedicated fallback routing. Will finish and push in 20m.

emily: Ill write the hero and the webinar blurb. Marketing wants a single stat for the hero and a short footnote to the perf appendix. Any clean number?

ben: From bench: typical web p95 shows ~34% token cost reduction with batching+quantization. Recommend "up to 34%" on the hero and link to full report for details.

rachel: Webinar is set for Fri 11:00 PT. Well run a 20m demo + 25m Q&A. Claire, do we want a separate CTA for enterprise lead routing vs general signups?

claire: Yes — two CTAs. General webinar form + an "enterprise trial" button that tags HubSpot with "sales:enterprise". Need UTM params and hidden field instructions from devs.

josh: Ill add the hidden fields and UTM support to the landing. Use utm_source=announce, utm_campaign=release-1.3. Will post the preview link after deploy.

deploy-bot: preview deploy successful: https://staging.redwood.ai/releases/1.3-preview (expires in 7 days). build#9911.

emily: grabbing screenshots now for social cards. Also drafting social copy: short, tech-forward, link to docs + webinar CTA.

ben: changelog merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.3. Docs canonical published at https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3 with migration notes and a perf appendix.

rachel: added HubSpot mapping for enterprise CTA and webhook to marketing inbox. RSVP flows into hubspot list "webinar-release-1-3".

claire: final checklist: 1) hero + stat (emily/ben), 2) changelog permalink (josh), 3) docs canonical (ben), 4) preview screenshots (emily), 5) HubSpot hooks + UTMs (josh/rachel). If green by 4pm Ill schedule the announce at 09:00 PT and publish the newsroom card.

josh: FYI ops: canary rollout scheduled Sat 08:30 PT with 10% initial traffic and 2h rollback window if p95 latency regresses >10%. Command used: `deployctl rollout start --env=prod --tag=v1.3 --canary=10%`

emily: Ill include a short benchmark blurb in the hero: "Up to 34% lower per-token cost on typical web workloads" and a footnote linking to the perf appendix.

claire: great. tagging the calendar invites and scheduling social. Will post the queued publish URLs here when scheduled. :rocket:
